name: ASBISc Enterprises Plc
summary: ASBISc Enterprises Plc, operating alongside its various subsidiaries, is engaged in the wholesale distribution and sale of a wide array of computer hardware and software products. The company offers an extensive range of technological solutions, including infrastructure for data centers, collaboration platforms, mobile computing, point-of-sale systems, Internet of Things (IoT) applications, tools for remote work, video surveillance, cloud services, and storage management. Additionally, ASBISc provides expertise in software-defined infrastructure, high-performance computing (HPC), General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) compliance, and digital signage technologies. Its product catalog features vital components such as servers, data storage units, networking equipment, security systems, client devices, storage upgrades, and other computing accessories. ASBISc serves a broad spectrum of industries, including telecommunications, education, government, manufacturing, sports, transportation, agriculture, automotive, betting, construction, data management facilities, financial services, healthcare, hospitality, wholesale and retail trade, IT services, legal and social sectors, and public utilities. Founded in 1990, the company is headquartered in Limassol, Cyprus.
